Careers

ProcessGene’s employees enjoy a pleasant and creative work environment with abundant opportunities for personal growth. Future employees at ProcessGene will play an important role in shaping the company’s products and character.

To apply please contact us here.

Positions Available

Software Development

 

Software Engineer, Server-Side Team Leader

To lead a website server-side core application development team.
Position Requirements:

  • Experienced software engineer, highly motivated, self-directed learner.
  • Proven experience in leading a software team.
  • Experience in one or more of the following: Object Oriented programming, Java, VBA , PHP, mySQL, MS-Visio, ActiveX.

 

Java Software Engineers, Server-Side

To fit in as key figures in a server-side core application development team.
Position Requirements:

  • Outstanding, creative programmers interested in working in an environment that emphasizes correct software engineering & development.
  • Experience in one or more of the following a plus: Object Oriented programming, Java, EJB, JSP, HTML and Web-environment programming.
  • People with outstanding experience in the IDF’s computer science and technological units are welcome to apply.

 

Software Engineer, Client-Side Team Leader

To lead a client-side application development team. The application will allow content display in a browser environment.

Position Requirements:

  • Experienced software engineer, highly motivated, self-directed learner.
  • Proven experience in leading a software team.
  • Experience in one or more of the following: Java programming, Object Oriented programming, VBA.

 

Business Development

 

Business Development Manager

To independently carry out business development and sales activities.

Position Requirements:

  • Industrial Engineer, preferably Technion graduate.
  • At least three years of experience in ERP/CRM/SCM/BPM sales and business development
